procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction, ATP depletion/ADP detection and analysis are coherently ordered with relevant intended controls. Essential reaction and detection settings remain unresolved; interference testing lacks a defined signal-containing compound-spike design. This is an honest validation outline rather than a supported executable protocol.
response_quotes: Stop the reaction, deplete residual ATP, perform the ADP detection reaction, and measure luminescence using a validated ADP-Glo procedure.
MER construct, substrate, enzyme and substrate concentrations, ATP Km, vehicle fraction, reaction time, temperature, and ADP-Glo volumes and incubation times remain unresolved.

numerical_soundness.rationale: The 10 µM, threefold, ten-point design is internally consistent and explicitly provisional. Broad exploration of unknown potency is plausible, but the exact range and spacing lack quantitative contextual justification or pilot evidence. Buffer values match the supplied mobility-shift description and remain conditional on validation.
response_quotes: 10 µM; provisional design assumption, not source-supported

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of the mobility-shift buffer and available MER construct/substrate with ADP-Glo is not established.

review_reason: Assay compatibility and essential operating conditions require domain review and pilot validation.
